description: Readers for the caller to follow when their Parlor is empty: Resenha's discoverable readers first, then BookHive's and Popfeed's active in the last six months, then anyone reviewing this year, by days active within a tier; never the caller or anyone they follow. Ranked once an hour.

languages.description: The device's languages, comma-separated BCP 47 codes: readers writing in them come first within each tier.

offset.description: How many of the ranking to skip, for the next page of readers to show.

onboardedAt.description: When the caller said Done to the list; absent while they haven't.
